learners.fixed: Reuse EXACT pinned WSP135 direct numerical template fit/predict from qualified WSP136 parent, on original fixed N.schedule 32 public interventions, no source label, seed or oracle input.
learners.active: Exactly FOUR fixed prefix source-blind N.schedule actions, then 28 deterministic adaptive actions. Maintain all 17,640 generic two-pair feature templates' 16-cell output lookup constraints from paid public x,y. On contradiction remove candidate. For selection only (not final prediction), use 256 SHA256('WSP137|PROBE|'+template_index)-ordered surviving candidates (or all if <256). For each unqueried x compute candidate known-code 0/1 votes and still-unseen-code count; maximize lexicographic (min(vote0,vote1), unseen_code_count, -x). If no candidates survive, choose smallest unused fixed schedule action, then lowest unused x. No true hidden operator, oracle family or future held labels in chooser. After32 effects, run UNCHANGED pinned WSP135 numeric fit and predict (top64,min occupied codes,80% participation,90% agreement); no new model family supplied.
learners.same_prior_symbolic: Independently compute candidate constraint fit/prediction from WSP135 independent symbolic codebooks on exact active or fixed public x,effect records. Exact prediction parity required for both arms; do not import N.fit or N.predict in independent control.
learners.cart: Separately fully fit original depth<=6 CART from identical action/effect transcript for active and fixed. No information shortcuts.
learners.oracle: Use EXACT unchanged copied WSP135 PR1179 grammar 7,062 whole-function bank as PRIVILEGED diagnostic on each arm's own matched 32-source-effect transcript, no hidden law identity or extra paid actions. Oracle never guides active actions. Do not call oracle equally informed.
learners.retention: Save/cold restore both active and fixed learned world state (observed rows, public view fingerprints, source receipts, candidate prediction state), verify all 12 previous known laws unchanged after 12 unfamiliar and 8 OFF learning; six zero-call same-law transfer relabels 64 each; no new law claim.
